# Product comparison

| Product | Price | Project limit | Retention | Export |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Atlas | 120 USD | 40 projects | 7 days | CSV |
| Birch | 180 USD | 75 projects | 14 days | JSON |
| Cedar | 240 USD | 90 projects | 30 days | XML |

## Recommendation

**Birch is the balanced default recommendation** if you want a middle-ground option: compared with Atlas, it costs 60 USD more while offering 35 additional projects and 7 more days of retention; it is still 60 USD less than Cedar. Choose Atlas if minimizing price is the priority, or Cedar if the highest project limit and longest retention matter most. Export formats differ, so confirm that the selected format fits your workflow.
